auth_details: Bearer token (Cloudflare API Token) in Authorization header; token needs Workers AI permissions. Account ID required in path. Self-serve signup via Cloudflare dashboard.
free_tier_limits: Free and Workers Paid: 10,000 Neurons/day included; Workers Paid overage $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons after daily free allocation. Models priced in Neurons per unit (tokens, audio seconds, etc.) — check pricing page for current per-model rates.
paid_plans: Workers Paid ($5/month minimum) unlocks higher usage; overage $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons after daily free allocation. Some models have unit prices (e.g. Whisper $0.00045/audio-minute equivalent in Neurons).
rate_limits: Default Cloudflare API rate limits apply; Workers AI also has model-specific concurrency and request size limits documented per model. Exact global RPS not published as a single number — not fully published beyond API platform defaults.
description: Cloudflare Workers AI lets developers run inference on popular open-source LLMs, embeddings, image, speech, and other models at the edge. Access is via the Cloudflare API at /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/ai/run/{model}, or from Cloudflare Workers with the AI binding. Authentication uses a Cloudflare API token with Workers AI permissions. Pricing is usage-based with free daily neuron allocations on Free and Workers Paid plans.
resolution_notes: Pending live verification of auditor disputes on rate_limits and pricing.paid_plans against official Cloudflare docs.
